introHtml: Harriton sweaters and cardigans are a go-to for corporate apparel that feels substantial and looks professional. The Pilbloc™ V-Neck Button Cardigan, available in men's and ladies' cuts, resists pilling even after repeated wear—making it a smart choice for uniforms or employee gifts that need to last. Add your logo with embroidery or screen printing for a clean, classic finish that works across industries.
